name: Two-Arm Dumbbell Kickback
research: Standing hinge, flat back: root rot X +60 (+X = lean forward), spine bones 0, neck/head -15 to keep the head in line. Hip offset from root after +60 = (0.11, -0.03, -0.04): root (0,0.20,0.97) -> hip (0.11,0.17,0.93); ankles at the standing spot (+-0.13,-0.01,0.074): hip-ankle 0.87 m -> knee bend ~29 deg (soft knees), hips back over the heels. Shoulder = root + (0.22,-0.44,0.17) -> (0.22,-0.24,1.14). Torso frame (lean 60): Y_t = (0,-0.5,-0.87), Z_t = (0,-0.87,0.5) world. Upper arm elev 20 / plane -90: du_t = (0,-0.34,-0.94) -> world (0, 0.98, -0.17) = 10 deg below level, pointing back (ACE: parallel to/close to the torso). Start forearm vertical: angle between du and world down = acos(0.17) = 80 -> elbow 80, bend_world down. End elbow 5. Neutral axis: start thumbs forward = world -Y in torso = [0,0.5,0.87] (square to the vertical forearm); end the thumb turns with the forearm 80 deg -> world (0,-0.17,-0.98) = torso [0,0.94,-0.34] (handle vertical at lockout). Fix 12 Nov (review: start read as a row, plates pressed into the thighs, red read as upper back): upper arms stay pinned back along the torso (elev 30 / plane -70: level, pointing back, elbows 5 cm out so the plates clear the thighs; FK check: plate rim to thigh surface +3..4 cm, was -5.7 cm), forearm hangs ~20 deg forward of vertical (elbow 112, bend_world [0,-0.4,-1]) at the start, straight (elbow 5) at the end. Handle square to the forearm, neutral: start axis [0,0.1,0.99] (thumbs forward), end [0,0.92,-0.4] (thumbs down, handle vertical). Camera yaw -100 / pitch 28: from above and a little behind his right side, so the back of the upper arm (triceps) faces the camera instead of being seen edge-on against the back. Right hand = the mirrored left (prop db_R). S1 Boehler 2011 (ACE kickback form + EMG), S2 Akima 2021.
